benchmark.method: Two independent runs per side, five rounds per run; pooled ten-round medians. Same compiled harness, Node 24.21.0 and host. Variations below 5% are reported as roughly unchanged; these samples do not establish a statistically significant difference. Pressure measures overload rejection, not accepted throughput.

beforeRuns.workload: Serial synthetic QQ events; native Response bodies without real networking; 64 KiB synthetic image bytes; a 513-value enumeration; default capacities. The pressure case measures correct overload rejection after filling 10000 retained reply scopes. RSS is sampled, not a peak or leak measurement. Compare identical harnesses on the same host.

soak.scope: Native-clock local sustained run with simulated HTTP and transport, short TTLs and injected errors. Includes guards, slot/rest/option, cooldown, private/group multi-turn prompts, cancellation, timeout, question failure and shutdown. Samples force GC and retain at most 240 points. This is not QQ platform or multi-day production acceptance.

retentionProbe.kind: context middleware plus reply, forced GC while dedup/reply caches retained
